svg.title: Token-level cancellation: the chosen and rejected answers share a prefix whose gradients cancel; only the tokens after they diverge get gradient

svg.text: 灰色：共享前缀，梯度互相抵消 / grey: shared prefix, gradients cancel

text.style: font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; fill: #86868B; font-weight: normal

svg.text: 着色：分叉之后，才有梯度 / coloured: after they diverge, gradient flows
